definition: One kit per style, filling every slot as specified, inherited, open or forbidden, with a column showing which ancestor each value came from. This is where a style becomes buildable rather than merely describable.
basis: Editorial, from VISION.md's fourth layer: "One kit per node, materialising every slot, so that selecting a style resolves to a directory of specified, inherited, open or forbidden elements" "with a source column showing which ancestor each value came from." "This is where a style becomes buildable rather than merely describable."
